concept: SIMD Aligned Memory Vectorization and Super-block K-Quants
summary: Source-anchored research for SIMD Aligned Memory Vectorization and Super-block K-Quants. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Super-block K-quants (Q4_K) group 256 weights into chunks with a shared FP16 super-block scale and eight 6-bit sub-block scales, reducing quantization noise in attention projection layers. (high confidence)
32-byte memory alignment prevents unaligned memory access penalties and cacheline splits during vectorized 256-bit SIMD load instructions across host CPU and GPU threads. (high confidence)
